$schema_note: Source of truth for the HairBarbot user app's colors and shape. Edit this file, then run `python3 design/build_tokens.py` to regenerate design/ios/BrandColors.swift and design/web/tokens.css. Never edit the generated files by hand.

primary.use: Main buttons, links, selected states, progress

primaryPressed.use: Pressed or active state of primary

warmWhite.use: Occasional warm surface (onboarding, success cards); light mode only

stop.use: SAFETY ONLY: blade off, emergency stop, error, the STOP button

onStop.use: Text on stop (white fails contrast on dark-mode stop)

warn.use: SAFETY ONLY: wait or adjust (rollers moving, move slower, low battery)

ok.use: SAFETY ONLY: ready to cut, connected. Not for 'area done' fills

fadeRamp.use: Hair-length maps and legends only. Index 0 = longest hair, last = shortest. Same in light and dark mode. Always pair with a numeric length label.

web.text: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
